cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm managing Mum's birthday invitations. What time have you got? I'm checking everyone's working from my latest details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, that reached you. And which restaurant name have you written? I'll check that matches too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've written nothing. You promised to do the invitations, and I'm not taking them over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course not. I'll do every one. Just read the booking on my phone while I type; stop whenever you like. I'm only checking the information traveled correctly.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 presents basic missing time as management checking; A3 asks missing name through the same cover; A5 guarantees B no takeover and limited reading to preserve help.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 time causes A3 claim the update reached B; B4 no draft and refusal cause A5 switching to phone dictation while A types.

relationship.evidence: B4 protects against unpromised invitation labor; A5 explicitly keeps every invitation and offers an exit from the smaller help.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts checking B nonexistent draft into checking information read from A own phone, exposing increasing dependence without admission.

specificity.evidence: A1 birthday invitation management and B2 recent booking establish what A should know.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 information-traveled cover is deliberately strained; the concrete read/type split keeps it playable.
